required_fields: IR calibration/reference ID and emissivity mapping
measured hot/cold boundary and ambient values
raw temperature array or qualified source data path/hash
coordinate transform and registered core/background masks
measurement uncertainty and invalid/masked pixel flags

profile_source_rules.cloak_and_concentrator: K1/K2 and C1/C2 align with the imposed-gradient direction
profile_source_rules.rotator: R1/R2 run transversely to the imposed-gradient direction
profile_source_rules.constraint: Do not apply a common line-direction rule to all three families

record_layers.source_reference: Static, cited reported claims and parameters. Never inserted into observed data.
record_layers.synthetic_fixture: Boolean and identity test tokens; no temperature, heat-flux or physical trajectory synthesis.
record_layers.qualified_observed: External receipts, actual measured boundary/ambient values and raw data identity required; unavailable here.

orientation_contract: Store condition coordinate frame and explicit orientation transform with every run. Do not infer direction from shape symmetry. Transform profiles/masks together.
boundary_rule: Controller reference and elapsed movie/clock time are not measured specimen boundary temperatures.
stability_rule: A reported 45-minute interval is context only. An approved bounded drift/uncertainty contract and qualified decision are required.
